about: The co-driver's lines (9 October 2026: pace notes and snide remarks from a Scottish co-driver, 'not just me but we'). 'text' is shown as a subtitle; 'say' (when present) is the spelling the voice engine is given, to steer it towards the accent. Pace-note calls come from Assets/HandlingLab/Rallycross/pacenotes.json. 'when' is the event that can trigger the line (web/rallycross/src/codriver.js).

lines.text: That's no' the road, by the way.
lines.say: That's no the road, by the way.

lines.text: Grass is for coos, no' cars.
lines.say: Grass is for coos, no cars.

lines.text: Aye, very scenic. Road's over there.
We're meant tae stay on the track, ye ken.
lines.say: We're meant tay stay on the track, ye ken.

lines.text: Lovely view o' where we've been.
lines.say: Lovely view o where we've been.

lines.text: Well. That's one way tae turn.
lines.say: Well. That's one way tay turn.

lines.text: That was a three wi' hope.
lines.say: That was a three, wi hope.

lines.text: That was a four wi' hope.
lines.say: That was a four, wi hope.

lines.text: That was a five wi' hope.
lines.say: That was a five, wi hope.

lines.text: That was a six wi' hope.
lines.say: That was a six, wi hope.

lines.text: Brakes are the middle pedal, pal.
Did I say don't cut? I did say don't cut.
Inside's no' part o' the track.
lines.say: Inside's no part o the track.

lines.text: Aye... no' bad. Don't let it go tae yer head.
lines.say: Aye. No bad. Don't let it go tay yer head.

lines.text: Personal best! I'll tell yer mum.
That one doesnae count, by the way.
lines.say: That one doesnay count, by the way.
